_note: PF resolution per season and topic cycle, used by scripts/ingest-opencaselist.mjs to label newly ingested cases. 2024-25 and 2025-26 are taken from the existing archive's frontmatter. Fill in the exact NSDA wording for each new topic as it is released; a blank resolution only means the card page shows no topic line.

2024-2025.september-october: The United States federal government should substantially expand its surveillance infrastructure along its southern border.
2024-2025.november-december: The United States should substantially reduce its military support of Taiwan.
2024-2025.january: The African Union should grant diplomatic recognition to the Republic of Somaliland as an independent state.
2024-2025.february: The United States should accede to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court.
2024-2025.march: In the United States, the benefits of the use of generative artificial intelligence in education outweigh the harms.
2024-2025.april: The United States federal government should substantially increase its investment in domestic nuclear energy.

2025-2026.september-october: The United Kingdom should rejoin the European Union.
2025-2026.november-december: The United States federal government should require technology companies to provide lawful access to encrypted communications.
2025-2026.january: The People's Republic of China should substantially reduce its international extraction of natural resources.
2025-2026.february: The Federal Trade Commission should establish a federal regulatory framework for sports betting.
2025-2026.march: The United States federal government should ban corporate acquisition of single-family residences.
2025-2026.april: The United States should eliminate the President's authority to deploy military forces abroad without Congressional approval.
2025-2026.nationals: The United States is justified in using force to remove authoritarian leaders from power.
